categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Planning & Design Research Institute Co., Ltd. primarily engages in urban and rural planning design, engineering design, engineering general contracting and management, and smart city services. The company offers comprehensive solutions covering the entire lifecycle of urban development, including land use planning, architectural design, municipal engineering, landscape design, and digital infrastructure for smart cities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced urban planning methodologies, engineering design standards, and integrates digital technologies such as big data analytics, AI, 3D modeling, and digital twin platforms. It develops proprietary software platforms for smart city management and employs data fusion, machine learning algorithms, and dynamic simulation technologies to enhance urban infrastructure planning and management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies at various levels, real estate developers, infrastructure investors, and public institutions involved in urban and rural development. The company serves markets focused on new urbanization, regional coordinated development, urban renewal, rural revitalization, and smart city construction, primarily within China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Jiangsu Province, especially the southern Jiangsu region, with expanding presence in the Yangtze River Delta and Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. It has established 22 branch offices to provide localized services and is actively developing markets in other provinces and major Chinese cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Planning & Design Research Institute operates primarily in the midstream segment of the urban development supply chain, providing intellectual and technical services such as planning, design, and project management. It acts as a key service provider bridging government policy and construction execution, with some involvement in engineering general contracting and project management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on regional expansion, integration of planning and engineering services, and digital transformation towards smart city solutions. R&D priorities include multi-source data fusion, intelligent evaluation technologies for urban renewal, dynamic traffic simulation, digital twin modeling, and low-efficiency land identification. It emphasizes enhancing digital capabilities, developing proprietary platforms, and fostering talent to support innovation and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based service contracts including planning design fees, engineering design fees, engineering general contracting management fees, and software product sales and maintenance in smart city projects. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong market position in Jiangsu Province and the Yangtze River Delta region, recognized for comprehensive qualifications and technical expertise. It competes with other regional and national urban planning and engineering design firms, leveraging its integrated service model and digital innovation to differentiate itself. It is regarded as a leading player in historical and cultural urban protection and smart city technology application.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 308 million, a 21.24% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 29 million, down 62.77%. Despite revenue and profit declines due to project delays and reduced new orders, the company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 1.38 billion and continues investing in R&D with a 7.59% revenue ratio. It is in a growth phase with strategic regional expansion and digital transformation initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Planning & Design Research Institute offers integrated, full-lifecycle urban development solutions combining traditional planning and engineering design with cutting-edge digital technologies. Its unique value lies in deep local market knowledge, comprehensive multi-disciplinary capabilities, strong brand reputation, and innovative smart city platforms that enhance decision-making and urban management efficiency. The company emphasizes high-quality service, technical innovation, and sustainable urban development aligned with national strategies.
